items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: We used to play with Mel then. I was playing with Melvin then.

ctx.x: Wasn't that, ain't that the time when I would bat up in Central? When y'all used to come over and visit us on Sunday when we was off? You remember when I was playing with Bat Brown at Suckoff's place? He used to play at Lewis. In Central, Lewis Suckoff.

No, but we was playing, we was playing for Miss Swutchikon then. Oh. What's her name? We used to play with Mel then. I was playing with Melvin then. Oh. I was in 37. Oh, oh. And rolling at 11. But this is later when you played near us in Central. I was in Central there. Oh yeah, in 37. Yeah. You see that was June of 36 in Rio Dosa. Uh-uh. And man, that boy had a fine band. We'd go up there and listen to them. The voice, he had seven pieces. Uh-huh. And we couldn't play with about four or five numbers. Dino, Sweet…
Boy, listen. People was around that dance like that. Yes, indeed. I'm telling, waiting for y'all. Yeah. So we five come from Rio Dosa, the boss left us off that Thursday night.
